title: fix(metadata): the in-memory store keys agent and skill by (package, name), so one package's register never overwrites another's (ADR-0150 D3/D4)
body:
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB94azKXgCZ6PLDNxoHzuy8r)_ Fixes #32151 Clause-②: no (narrowing) Metadata-protocol: none Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` and `content/docs/**` teach no in-process `get('agent' | 'skill', …)` and no `/layers?package=` read of an agent or skill; the refusal names every holder to address. Narrowing: two in-process answers of the metadata service, no HTTP or MCP door on a booted stack. 1. `get` / `getDiagnosed('agent' | 'skill', name)` naming no package, for a name two packages hold: FROM the item of the package registered last TO `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` (`PackageScopedNameRefusedError`, `ambiguous-in-environment`) naming both holders, the shape `api` took in #32092. Fix: name a package the refusal lists. 2. `get` / `getDiagnosed('agent' | 'skill', name, PKG)` where PKG holds no slot of the name and another package does, one holder or more: FROM the stored item (the one holder's, or the survivor of two) TO `undefined` / `{ data: undefined, degraded: false, errors: [] }`, with no loader asked in its place. Fix: name the holding package (the bare read's refusal, or `list`, names it). On a host with no merged protocol read, the MCP agent and skill reads fall back to the metadata service and get item 1's refusal where they were served the survivor. Fix line (defect on main), FROM → TO: on an artifact boot (`os dev`, `os start`), `GET /meta/agent|skill/NAME/layers?package=ALPHA` for a name alpha and beta both hold goes FROM beta's body (code and effective layer, `packageId` beta) TO alpha's own body. ## 维护者速读 1. 两个不同命名空间的包可以各自装一个同名的 agent 或 skill（#31701 起允许），但元数据服务的内存仓库按名字存，后注册的包会把先注册的那份覆盖掉。 2. 用户可见的后果：在 `os dev` / `os start` 下，按包查看 agent 或 skill 的分层视图（`/layers?package=`）会拿到另一个包的内容，这是 main 上的缺陷。 3. 本 PR 让 agent、skill 和 api 一样按"包 + 名字"各占一个槽，谁的就是谁的，互不覆盖，列表里两份都在。 4. 收紧的行为有两处，都在进程内：不指明包去取两个包都有的名字，过去静默给后注册的那个，现在拒绝（409）并列出两个持有包；指明一个并不持有该名字的包去取，过去给出别的包的那份，现在什么也不给。HTTP 和 MCP 入口本来就这样拒绝，不受影响。 5. 只有一个包持有某名字时，不指明包或指明持有包的读取逐字节不变（已用哈希对照），指明别的包的读取属于第 4 条的第二处；示例应用里没有声明 agent 或 skill，第一方影响为 0。 6. 加了一道守卫：今后把新类型收窄到命名空间却忘了给它分槽，objectql 的测试会直接变红。 ## Step 0 — reader census on a booted two-namespace composition Fixture: two packages of two namespaces (`com.qa.slot.alpha`, `com.qa.slot.beta`), each holding one agent and one skill of the same name, registered alpha then beta. Booted twice: the **artifact door** (`MetadataPlugin` with `artifactSource`, the `os dev` / `os start` path, which registers every package body's items with the metadata service) and the **config door** (`AppPlugin` registers; agent and skill never reach the metadata service). Readings for `agent`; `skill` read identically on every row. | Reader (file · symbol) | Door | main `45f0f81f` | this PR | |---|---|---|---| | `MetadataManager.get(agent, NAME, alpha)` / `(…, beta)` (`metadata-manager.ts` · `get`) | artifact | **beta's item for both** | each package's own | | `MetadataManager.get` / `getDiagnosed(agent, NAME)`, no package | artifact | beta's item | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming both (the narrowing) | | `MetadataManager.list(agent)` rows of NAME | artifact | beta's only | alpha's and beta's | | `MetadataManager.getPublished(agent, NAME)`, no package (in-process) | artifact | beta's item | `409` naming both | | `MetadataManager.get(agent, SOLO, beta)` · `getDiagnosed(…)`, a non-holder of a one-holder name | artifact | **alpha's item** · `{ data: alpha's }` | `undefined` · `{ data: undefined, degraded: false, errors: [] }` (narrowing 2) | | `MetadataManager.get(agent, NAME, gamma)`, a non-holder of a two-holder name | artifact | beta's item | `undefined` (narrowing 2) | | `GET /meta/agent/NAME/layers?package=alpha` (`protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts` · `getMetaItemLayered`) | artifact | **200, code and effective = beta's body, `packageId` beta — defect** | 200, alpha's own body | | `GET /meta/agent/NAME/layers?package=beta` | artifact | 200, beta's | 200, beta's | | `GET /meta/agent/SOLO/layers?package=beta` · `/meta/agent/NAME/layers?package=gamma` (a non-holder) | artifact | 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, D5 "not held by package …, which the address names exactly" | identical bytes (md5 `aa041e6c…` · `7dfb2763…`) | | `GET /meta/agent/NAME` bare · `/layers` bare · `/published` bare | both | 409 naming both | 409 naming both (byte-identical) | | `GET /meta/agent/NAME?package=X` · `/meta/agent/NS/NAME` (`exactQualifierItem`) | both | each its own | each its own (byte-identical) | | `GET /meta/agent` list rows of NAME | artifact | beta's, alpha's | alpha's, beta's (order only) | | MCP `prompts/get alpha-NAME` / `beta-NAME` · bare `NAME` | both | each its own · `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` | unchanged | | `MetadataManager.get` / `list`, any package | config | `undefined` / `[]` (never registered) | unchanged | | every HTTP / MCP door above | config | correct | unchanged | | `MetadataManager.unregisterPackage(alpha)` then reads | artifact | removes nothing (see Acceptance notes) | removes nothing (see Acceptance notes) | Static census of the other generic readers whose type can be agent or skill: - `packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts` · `diagnosedGet(metadataService, type, name)` (`:643`, `:706`): runs only when no protocol merged read is bound; booted, the merged read answers first (MCP rows above). - `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts` · `list('skill')`: same fallback, only without a merged read. - `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts:2156` · `metaSvc.getItem(...)`: `MetadataManager` has no `getItem`, so this branch never reaches it. - `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-metadata-service-read.ts` · `readMetaItem` step 2 (`getDiagnosed(t, name, packageId)`): a two-holder bare read is refused by `packagelessScopedRead` before step 2; with one holder the answer is unchanged. - `MetadataManager`'s own no-package gets (`getPublished`, `importMetadata` merge, `publishPackage` dependency check): one holder reads as before; a two-holder name now refuses instead of reading the survivor. - `packages/core/src/security/security-catalog.ts`, `plugin-security` `security-catalog-echo.ts`: security-catalog types only, never agent or skill. - `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-registry-hydration.ts` · `restoreArtifactRegistryView` (`:1421`), the heal after a stored row's delete, makes a bare `readItemFromMetadataService(type, name)`. For a two-holder name it re-registered the survivor under the plain key on main; it now meets item 1's refusal inside its silent outer `catch` and re-registers nothing, leaving the registry entry as it was. Read from the code, not measured; no door's answer moves. ## What changes - `packages/metadata/src/package-slotted-store.ts`: `agent` and `skill` join `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES` beside `api`. Every rule the set drives was already in place for `api` (#32092): a write fills its package's slot, a read naming a package reads only that slot, a read naming none follows D3 (environment item, else the unique holder, else a refusal naming every holder), list enumerates every slot of a name, and removal is by slot. The module doc gains a "Which types" section naming the rule that a type joins the namespace-scoped set only in the change that slots it here. - No public export is added: the set stays off `@objectstack/metadata`'s entry. ## Why ADR-0150 D3 needs each holder's item to exist before any reader resolves a bare name; a store keyed by bare name drops one holder at register time, so no reader downstream can be right. #31700 reads agents and skills by package and needs every package's item present. ## Acceptance notes - **`unregisterPackage` removes nothing for artifact-door items** (`_packageId` only). On the artifact door the registered body carries `_packageId` but no `packageId` envelope, and `MetadataManager.unregisterPackage(id)` (`metadata-manager.ts:1960`) selects items by `packageId` or `package`, so it removed none of them on main and removes none on this head (probe, after `unregisterPackage(alpha)`: main still answers beta's item for every read, head still answers alpha's and beta's). Reach: no in-tree production caller (`git grep -n "\.unregisterPackage\b" -- 'packages/**' ':!**/*.test.ts' ':!**/dist/**'` finds no call site; the two `unregisterPackage(` definitions are the manager's own and objectql `MetadataFacade`'s, which clears `SchemaRegistry`, not the metadata service). Items that carry `packageId` are removed by slot (unit pin). Left to the seat whether this becomes a card. - **`readMetaItem` step 2 swallows a service throw**: the branch that would surface the new refusal without a `readsByPackage` source is #32076's, not this card's; booted, `packagelessScopedRead` answers first. - **REST list order and the realtime event**: `GET /meta/agent` (and `skill`) lists a two-holder name's rows in registration order (alpha, beta) where main listed beta then alpha (the survivor first); one-holder lists are byte-identical. The second holder's first register publishes `metadata.TYPE.created` where main published `updated` (the overwrite), from `writeRegistryEntry`'s `existed`. Both are in the changeset. - **`/layers?package=` a non-holder, measured (contract review S1)**: the review derived a wrong-to-wrong 200 here. Measured on the artifact boot, it is `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` with core's D5 sentence ("not held by package …, which the address names exactly"), byte-identical on the main-behaviour build and on this head, for a one-holder name and a two-holder one (census rows above; md5 `aa041e6c…`, `7dfb2763…` for agent, `62a0463b…`, `1bb8361c…` for skill). The layered door already refuses a non-holder before the service answers, so no admission is missing there. Pinned as a dogfood CONTROL. - **A package-less write under a two-holder name (contract review ④)**: it lands in the name's bare slot, `list` enumerates it beside the two package items, and no by-name read answers it (a read naming a package reads that slot; the bare read refuses naming the two package holders). D4 reads such a row as a holder's customization, and with two holders there is no single holder for it, so the refusal stands. Pinned, so whichever rule is later chosen flips a test. - **Superset pin through behaviour (deviation, ruled by the seat)**: `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES` is not on metadata's public entry, and metadata cannot import objectql. The objectql pin iterates the live `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` export and asserts two packages' same-named items are both kept and each answered by package; a type added to that set later fails the pin until it is slotted. No export was added for the test. metadata's own "the slotted set holds every namespace-scoped type" case restates `['agent', 'skill']`, so the objectql case is the pin. When #32076 moves the set into core, whichever lands second merges `origin/main` and keeps both, and metadata can then pin membership directly. ## Verification Tests added: - `packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager-match-endpoint.test.ts`: the slotted set holds every namespace-scoped type; per type, a read naming a package answers its own and a non-holder answers nothing; a no-package `get` / `getDiagnosed` refuses `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT ambiguous-in-environment` naming both; a read naming a non-holder of a one-holder name answers nothing on both faces (narrowing 2); a package-less write beside two holders is stored, listed and unread; list shows both, and removing either package leaves the other for items that carry `packageId`. Today's gap pinned as it is: `unregisterPackage` removes nothing of a `_packageId`-only item (the seat's carry flips it). CONTROL: one package's item is returned as the same object for every read naming none or the holder, and an environment item answers any read. - `packages/objectql/src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.test.ts`: the superset pin above. - `packages/qa/dogfood/test/bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.dogfood.test.ts`: artifact boot, `/layers?package=` serves each package its own; the metadata service answers each package its own, refuses the bare read, and answers nothing to a non-holder. CONTROL: bare `/meta` and `/layers` stay `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` (code asserted) naming both, `/layers?package=` a non-holder stays `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming the holder, `?package=` serves each its own, and one-holder agent and skill are answered bare and by package.
